conventions: Preserve existing Apache 2.0 license headers and copyright years unchanged on all existing files.
Edit only TSDoc comments (/** ... */); never modify executable code, imports, exports, type signatures, parameter names, return types, or release tags (@public, @alpha, @deprecated).

Follow @backstage/catalog-model TSDoc conventions: a summary sentence, optional @remarks block separated by blank lines, release tag (@public) on top-level exports, followed by @param <name> - <description> and @returns <description> on functions/methods, using {@link ...} for symbol references.
Do not add release tags (@public or @alpha) to interface members or class methods whose enclosing interface or class already carries @public.
Format modified files with yarn prettier --write; never run eslint --fix or hand-edit report*.api.md files.

decisions.topic: TSDoc block placement on conditions.ts type guards
decisions.choice: Edit the existing single-tag /** @public */ block in place above each of the 8 exported type guard functions to include the summary, @public tag, @param entity, and @returns
rejected: Adding a second doc comment block above /** @public */
decisions.reason: API Extractor reads the single TSDoc comment block immediately preceding each exported declaration and requires the @public release tag to stay intact.

decisions.choice: Add concise /** ... */ doc comments above apiVersion, kind, and spec on each *EntityV1alpha1 interface matching the style of Entity in src/entity/Entity.ts without adding release tags or nested spec property comments
decisions.reason: Interface members inherit the release tag of their enclosing @public interface, and API Extractor only marks top-level apiVersion, kind, and spec as (undocumented) in report.api.md.

decisions.topic: TSDoc on EntityPolicy.enforce implementations and KubernetesValidatorFunctions static methods
decisions.choice: Add /** ... */ doc comments with summary, @param, and @returns above each enforce method in src/entity/policies/*EntityPolicy.ts and each static method in KubernetesValidatorFunctions.ts accurately describing its runtime behavior
rejected: Copying generic interface documentation without policy-specific or validator-specific details
decisions.reason: Requirements FR-10 through FR-15 and AC-3 require every TSDoc comment to state what the implementation in its source file actually does.

decisions.choice: Create .changeset/catalog-model-tsdoc.md with '@backstage/catalog-model': patch and an adopter-facing summary of the TSDoc additions
decisions.reason: TSDoc comments ship in published .d.ts files without changing runtime behavior, and Gate 0 froze a patch changeset for @backstage/catalog-model.

units.behaviour: Add TSDoc comment above DefaultNamespaceEntityPolicy.prototype.enforce describing its namespace defaulting behavior.
rules: 1. Insert a TSDoc /** ... */ comment block immediately above enforce(entity: Entity): Promise<Entity> without adding a release tag.
2. Do not modify any executable code, imports, signatures, or copyright headers.

sites.rule: Insert TSDoc comment block above enforce stating: 'Checks whether `entity.metadata.namespace` is already set; if so, returns `entity` unchanged, and otherwise returns a new merged entity with `metadata.namespace` populated with the policy\'s configured default namespace (`DEFAULT_NAMESPACE`, `"default"`, unless overridden in the constructor).', followed by '@param entity - The entity to enforce the policy on' and '@returns Resolves with the original entity if `metadata.namespace` is already set, or a new merged entity with the default namespace populated'.

units.behaviour: Add TSDoc comment above FieldFormatEntityPolicy.prototype.enforce describing the envelope fields validated and error behavior.
rules: 1. Insert a TSDoc /** ... */ comment block immediately above enforce(entity: Entity): Promise<Entity> without adding a release tag.
2. Do not modify any executable code, imports, signatures, or copyright headers.

sites.rule: Insert TSDoc comment block above enforce stating: 'Validates the format of `apiVersion`, `kind`, `metadata.name`, and (when present) `metadata.namespace`, `metadata.labels` (keys and values), `metadata.annotations` (keys and values), `metadata.tags`, and `metadata.links` (`url` required, `title` and `icon` optional non-empty strings) using the configured {@link Validators} and {@link CommonValidatorFunctions}, throwing an `Error` if a required field is missing (`undefined` or `null`) or any field fails format validation.', followed by '@param entity - The entity to validate' and '@returns Resolves with the unmodified entity when all fields are valid, or rejects with an `Error` if a required field is missing or fails format validation'.

units.behaviour: Add TSDoc comment above GroupDefaultParentEntityPolicy.prototype.enforce describing how default parent references are assigned to Group entities.
rules: 1. Insert a TSDoc /** ... */ comment block immediately above enforce(entity: Entity): Promise<Entity> without adding a release tag.
2. Do not modify any executable code, imports, signatures, or copyright headers.

sites.rule: Insert TSDoc comment block above enforce stating: 'Returns `entity` unchanged if `entity.kind !== "Group"` or `entity.spec.parent` is already set; otherwise, as long as the group\'s own entity reference (`stringifyEntityRef(entity)`) does not equal the configured default parent reference (preventing a group from becoming its own parent), sets `entity.spec.parent` to the configured default parent entity ref and returns the entity.', followed by '@param entity - The entity to enforce the policy on' and '@returns Resolves with the entity, with `spec.parent` populated if applicable'.

rules: 1. Insert a TSDoc /** ... */ comment block immediately above enforce(entity: Entity): Promise<Entity> without adding a release tag.

sites.rule: Insert TSDoc comment block above enforce stating: 'Checks every top-level key of `entity` (`Object.keys(entity)`) against the configured list of known root fields (defaulting to `["apiVersion", "kind", "metadata", "spec"]`), throwing an `Error` (`Unknown field <field>`) if any unrecognized root field is present.', followed by '@param entity - The entity to validate' and '@returns Resolves with the unmodified entity when all root fields are known, or rejects with an `Error` if an unrecognized root field is present'.

units.behaviour: Add TSDoc comments above all 8 static validator methods on KubernetesValidatorFunctions.
rules: 1. Insert a TSDoc /** ... */ comment block immediately above each of the 8 static methods on KubernetesValidatorFunctions without adding release tags.
2. Include a summary sentence accurately describing the validation rule, '@param value - The value to check', and '@returns `true` if ...' on each method.
3. Do not modify any executable code, imports, signatures, release tags, or copyright headers.

sites.rule: Insert TSDoc comment block above isValidApiVersion stating: 'Checks that the value is a valid API version string of the form `<suffix>` or `<prefix>/<suffix>`, where the optional `<prefix>` is a valid DNS subdomain ({@link CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsSubdomain}) and `<suffix>` is 1–63 ASCII alphanumeric characters (`/^[a-z0-9A-Z]+$/`).', followed by '@param value - The value to check' and '@returns `true` if the value is a valid API version string'.

Insert TSDoc comment block above isValidKind stating: 'Checks that the value is a valid kind string of 1–63 characters starting with an ASCII letter (`a-zA-Z`) followed by ASCII alphanumeric characters (`/^[a-zA-Z][a-z0-9A-Z]*$/`).', followed by '@param value - The value to check' and '@returns `true` if the value is a valid kind string'.

Insert TSDoc comment block above isValidObjectName stating: 'Checks that the value is a valid object name string of 1–63 characters starting and ending with an ASCII alphanumeric character (`A-Za-z0-9`) and containing only ASCII alphanumeric characters, `-`, `_`, or `.` in between (`/^([A-Za-z0-9][-A-Za-z0-9_.]*)?[A-Za-z0-9]$/`).', followed by '@param value - The value to check' and '@returns `true` if the value is a valid object name string'.

Insert TSDoc comment block above isValidNamespace stating: 'Checks that the value is a valid RFC 1123 DNS label namespace by delegating to {@link CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsLabel} (1–63 lowercase alphanumeric characters `[a-z0-9]` separated by `-`).', followed by '@param value - The value to check' and '@returns `true` if the value is a valid namespace string'.

Insert TSDoc comment block above isValidLabelKey stating: 'Checks that the value is a valid label key string of the form `<suffix>` or `<prefix>/<suffix>`, where the optional `<prefix>` is a valid DNS subdomain ({@link CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsSubdomain}) and `<suffix>` is a valid object name ({@link KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidObjectName}).', followed by '@param value - The value to check' and '@returns `true` if the value is a valid label key string'.

Insert TSDoc comment block above isValidLabelValue stating: 'Checks that the value is a valid label value: either an empty string (`""`) or a valid object name ({@link KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidObjectName}).', followed by '@param value - The value to check' and '@returns `true` if the value is a valid label value string'.

Insert TSDoc comment block above isValidAnnotationKey stating: 'Checks that the value is a valid annotation key string of the form `<suffix>` or `<prefix>/<suffix>`, where the optional `<prefix>` is a valid DNS subdomain ({@link CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsSubdomain}) and `<suffix>` is a valid object name ({@link KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidObjectName}).', followed by '@param value - The value to check' and '@returns `true` if the value is a valid annotation key string'.

Insert TSDoc comment block above isValidAnnotationValue stating: 'Checks that the value is a valid annotation value, which may be any string (`typeof value === "string"`).', followed by '@param value - The value to check' and '@returns `true` if the value is a string'.

units.behaviour: Create an adopter-facing patch changeset for @backstage/catalog-model summarizing the added TSDoc documentation.
rules: 1. Write YAML frontmatter delimited by --- lines containing only '@backstage/catalog-model': patch.

2. Follow the frontmatter with a blank line and a concise adopter-facing description stating: 'Added TSDoc documentation for entity kind interfaces, entity kind type guards, entity policies, and `KubernetesValidatorFunctions` in `@backstage/catalog-model`.'
3. Reference no internal or non-public symbols.
